title: Getting a Vega banjo and the musicians' union ring
summary: A banjo was given to him by John Bernard; he complains you cannot get jobs unless you are in the union ring.

story.theme_name: The musicians' union: cards, locals, and the Black-white merger
story.community_name: The musicians' union: cards, scale and the black-white merger

blocks.x: Where did you get that vega banjo?

Uh, he probably gave it to one of us. Oh, John Bernard gave it to one of us? That's right. One of the time, him and some other people came. I played a parade with John and they walked up and asked me, said, we went to two of the great banjo. I said, I did. He said, would you want one to come back? I said, yeah, I'll tell you. I thought he was joking. Went by his house and picked up the banjo. I said, I'm a father out there. But the trouble is, they got a ring. Now you can't get a break on a banjo. If you're not in that ring out there on Boyle Street, you can't get a job.
Oh no, you have to be in the city.
That's right, you got to be in that ring out there.
You got to belong to that ring. Yeah, well you could double. That's true. You can play two instruments, you should have it made. But you've got to get in.
